Standard: For multi-crewmember air vehicle escape systems, escape path clearance, clearance between individual escape systems and occupants, and debris (e.g., hatches and canopies) is maintained after air vehicle separation throughout the escape system envelope for worst case crewmember size combinations. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine escape system configuration and verify that the multi-crewmember escape systems incorporates a trajectory divergence function to prevent collisions between crewmembers.
(2) Examine the escape system configuration and verify that the sequencing logic and timing is maintained when automatic mode is selected. Analysis.
  (1) Validated dynamic trajectory simulations show that air vehicle escape path clearance is maintained for multi-crewmember escape systems throughout the escape system envelope. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Full multi-crewmember ejection sled testing shows that escape path clearance is maintained throughout for the escape system speed envelope for straight and level flight with worst case combinations of occupant size and weight.
